content: Food insecurity disproportionately affects certain segments of the population, with significantly higher prevalence among racial minorities, individuals from low-income households, and single-parent families. Among individuals with diabetes, food insecurity is associated with detrimental outcomes, including inadequate self-care behaviors, increased rates of depression, and poor adherence to prescribed medication regimens. These factors collectively contribute to a twofold increase in the risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
